caption: A language app with 36 players and a month of activity. Everything here runs on Gami.Fied.
Send traffic, and events arrive the way your app would send them.
Rules decide what an event is worth: XP, badges and gems.
Badges unlock from rules, with how many players have each one.
Daily streaks, with freezes that save a missed day.
Leaderboards by period, updated as XP lands.
Weekly leagues with promotion and relegation.
Players spend gems in a reward store, with stock and limits.
Every player, with their level, streak and history.
Self-hosted and open source. Your players and their data stay on your servers.
